ANGRAU Agromet Observer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: 10+2 with Science stream or above along with knowledge of computer and Typewriting (Multilingual) both Telugu and English. Candidate should have knowledge and experience in taking the Met data in the Observatory, Processing and sending data to IMD, maintenance of the Observatory and assisting in all works entrusted by Nodal Officer.

ANGRAU Agromet Observer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Agromet Observer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Agromet Observer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Agromet Observer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Agromet Observer post at ANGRAU is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Agromet Observer position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is 10+2 with a Science stream or above, along with computer knowledge and multilingual typewriting skills in both Telugu and English.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Agromet Observer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 21,700/- per month, plus Dearness Allowance (DA) and House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Agromet Observer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Agromet Observer post at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Agromet Observer recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What are the key responsibilities of an Agromet Observer?
faq.answer: The responsibilities include taking meteorological data, processing and sending it to IMD, maintaining the observatory, and assisting the Nodal Officer.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit specified for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ANGRAU office in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh (Pincode: 517502).

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.
